summary: The branch changes only wrangler.toml, package.json, and package-lock.json; no forbidden application or asset files changed and no Worker entry script was added. Direct inspection confirms an assets-only SPA deployment configuration and reproducible deploy command, while the supplied verification log records successful typecheck and production build runs.

criteria.evidence: wrangler.toml:20-24 declares name = "fragrance-motion-website", compatibility_date = "2026-09-11", and [assets].directory = "./dist". Inspection of the complete 27-line file confirms there is no [site] table.

wrangler.toml:23-27 sets [assets].not_found_handling = "single-page-application". vite.config.ts:4-9 confirms static output to dist with no SSR/server functions, and src/App.tsx:16-29 shows the single rendered application structure.

The complete wrangler.toml has no top-level main field. git diff --name-status master...HEAD lists only package-lock.json, package.json, and wrangler.toml, and the added-file list contains only wrangler.toml, so no TypeScript or JavaScript Worker entry script was introduced.

package.json:9 defines "deploy": "npm run build && wrangler deploy", which runs the existing tsc/Vite build before deployment; package.json:33 adds wrangler ^4.131.2 as a devDependency. package-lock.json:28 and package-lock.json:4910-4933 lock Wrangler 4.131.2 and its CLI metadata.

The supplied verification log records npm run typecheck exiting 0 and npm run build exiting 0, with Vite successfully transforming 43 modules and emitting dist/index.html plus bundled assets. git diff --name-only master...HEAD confirms no src/** files changed.
